description: Edit a text file in the project and return a unified diff of what changed. old_string must match the raw file exactly, without read_file's line-number prefix, and appear exactly once unless replace_all is set. Include enough surrounding context to make it unique. Use write_file to create a new file. Prefer this over shell commands such as sed, tee, or output redirection for changing files.

file_path.description: File path, relative to the project directory

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence of old_string; by default, exactly one occurrence is required
